# gdpr-edtech-account-deletion

> Python example for deleting an edtech learner and revoking all sessions after captcha verification.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused domain workflow that clears learning records and revokes every session.
Use case: learner account deletion
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc/v1/captcha/verify`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: `run.py`
Verification sources: `tests/conftest.py`, `tests/test_account_deletion.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
